method: Native 48 kHz excerpts with 0.5 seconds before and after each selected active or mandatory interval. Remote residual is master channel 0 minus the exact simultaneously recorded backing channel 0. Sender reference uses one constant locally correlated offset per context only when NCC >=0.2 with a unique peak; otherwise it retains the clock-derived hint and is explicitly unidentified. No stretching, resampling, gain normalization or dynamics. Context NCC is for clip identity only, not a replacement lag/drift acceptance result.
